title: Coproduct module sheaves as locally finite-coordinate tuples
statement:
Let $\mathcal C$ be a small site [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology] whose topology is given by covering families, with fibre products of objects, and let $\mathcal O$ be a sheaf of commutative rings on it. Assume the sheafification of presheaves of $\mathcal O$-modules exists [def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification]. Let $I$ be a set in the fixed sheaf universe and $(H_i)_{i\in I}$ a family of sheaves of $\mathcal O$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Form the sectionwise product $P=\prod_{i\in I}H_i$ [lem-weil-pbc-module-sheaves-colimits-forgetful]. Define a subpresheaf $S\subseteq P$ by
$$S(V)=\{(h_i)_i\in P(V):\ \text{there is a covering }\{V_a\to V\}_a\text{ and finite }B_a\subseteq I\text{ with }h_i|_{V_a}=0\text{ for }i\notin B_a\}.$$
Restrictions and module operations are induced from $P$. Then $S$ is a sheaf of $\mathcal O$-modules. For each $i$, the coordinate insertion $\iota_i:H_i\to P$ factors through $S$, and these maps make $S$ a coproduct of the $H_i$ [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]: for every sheaf of $\mathcal O$-modules $T$, composition with the $\iota_i$ is a bijection
$$\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal O}(S,T)\xrightarrow{\sim}\prod_{i\in I}\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal O}(H_i,T).$$
Consequently the canonical map $\bigoplus_{i\in I}H_i\to\prod_{i\in I}H_i$ is a monomorphism and its image is exactly this subsheaf $S$.
